name: REA (static analysis)
description: Static, no-execution analysis of local artifacts with the REA CLI: JavaScript/Electron apps, HAR or mitmproxy captures, .NET assemblies and Android APKs. Produces unverified observations only.
egress_note: The five allowed operations declare no network access in REA's capability catalog; inputs are local files inside the case directory.
risk_note: Static analysis shows what code and captures contain, not what an app did on a given device or who built it. Pinned to a reviewed release because REA ships breaking majors often.
